dedupe_keys.name: parametric studies for seismic risk of tall and slender vertical pressure vessels

description: Parametric Studies for Seismic Risk of Tall and Slender Vertical Pressure Vessels is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "other", published or maintained by Joel Conte, University of California San Diego (ucsd.edu). Pressure vessels are a critical element in the natural gas industry and are considered sensitive equipment because of their hazardous products. Therefore, they must be designed against any low-probability, high consequence event that may occur over the lifetime of the vessel plant, but minimal research on their seismic effects has been conducted. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "other" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-1edp-9782. Keywords: Pressure Vessels, Seismic Risk, Fragility Curves, ASME Code. Published 2021-09-10. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0 (labelled "Creative Commons Attribution" on the DesignSafe project). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
